title: Welcome to Ajaia Collaborative Docs
content:
Welcome to Ajaia Collab Docs

This is a modern collaborative rich text workspace powered by Next.js 14, TipTap, and Tailwind CSS.

Key Features

  • Real-time auto-saving with debouncing
  • Rich formatting: Bold, Italic, Underline, H1, H2, lists
  • File import: Direct upload of .txt and .md files
  • Role-based sharing: Switch between Alice, Bob, and Charlie to test owner, editor, and viewer permissions

Try switching users from the top-right dropdown to see real-time permission access changes!

title: Distributed State & Conflict Resolution RFC
content:
Distributed State & Conflict Resolution RFC

Authored by Bob.

This document details our evaluation between Operational Transformation (OT) and Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) like Yjs and Automerge.

Recommendation

For rich text editing with TipTap/ProseMirror, Yjs is the industry standard for decentralized consistency.
